name: P-013 run49 isolated two-host Papercup chat acceptance
summary: The frozen isolated operator desktop and the external portal both rendered and persisted the same choice-card interaction and markdown prose, rejected a duplicate answer with HTTP 409, rendered compact inline semantic timestamps for same-day and older turns, and exposed the Papercup identity to assistive technology without visible role text. The verifier tore down with exit=0.

assertions.evidence: Both hosts used card prompt SHA-256 a263b284f284a07f95b5844c16df9cf171db6e6da9310222b34258dc21dba899 and prose prompt SHA-256 3c27fbad8472865ea2eb989de6fbcaa93d8166060f151d5fce23d66b81d7950c.
Tauri result recorded visible question 'Choose P013 parity token', exactly Alpha/Beta options, persisted chat:ask_choice input, and answered pick Alpha.
Portal result recorded the same visible question and Alpha/Beta options, persisted chat:ask_choice input, and answered pick Alpha through the restricted PI tool surface.
Both hosts' second card-response attempts returned HTTP 409 after the Alpha answer had persisted.
Both DOM snapshots contained strong text 'P013 parity bold', list items first/second, and inline code 'inline' after one prose submission.
Both hosts rendered same-day HH:MM labels and an older 'Sep 5 · HH:MM' label in the message line beside content; every inspected time carried an ISO dateTime and was visible.
Both DOM snapshots reported zero visible assistant-role labels and screen-reader-only 'Papercup' labels; the desktop snapshot also recorded avatar icons.
Desktop DOM reported hostTrust=owner; portal DOM reported hostTrust=public. Portal PI discovery returned HTTP 200 and exposed only voice:delegate_deep and chat:ask_choice.

Operator health reported version 0.0.18 and source short SHA c9dd1a154a throughout; portal source HEAD cb9557c2f07e241850920f6da53975caccea754d with runtime fingerprint 11411279161c1cb34d733051f6dca1b3f69dc9fe4ebc0374912814454c2e2285 over 96 inputs.
